data.title: 萝丝 · 湖畔微风轻抚草帽
data.description: 清凉多瑙湖畔的青青草甸上。萝丝赤足踏在浅滩细浪中，单手轻按被湖风吹拂的草帽檐，白裙如荷花初绽，清澈的眼眸中没有战乱与阴谋，只有纯粹无瑕的浪漫情怀与温柔笑意。
data.location: serene lakeside meadow with blooming wildflowers and crystal water shallows
data.action: standing in shallow clear water, one hand securing her straw hat against the lake breeze, glancing back toward viewer with a breathless innocent smile
data.lighting: warm golden late-afternoon sun filtering across rippling lake water
data.mood: pure pastoral romance, untouched innocence, sweet tranquil peace
data.promptProse: Rose in a white frilled swimsuit stands in a crystal lake shallows, holding her straw hat against a gentle summer breeze with a radiant smile.
data.animaCaption: Holding her straw hat against the lake breeze, she smiles radiantly in the warm shallows.
